{{Top|leg}}
'''Ion torpedo launchers''' were [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]-mounted [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launchers]]. [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]] assigned to the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] ''[[Ion Storm]]'' were armed with [[Ion torpedo/Legends|ion torpedo]] launchers.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
